mapper.select:
select t.*, u.avatar, u.on_line as onLine, u.user_name as userName, g.game_name as gameName, g.game_img as gameImg, fot.content as fastContent, fot.voice as fastVoice, fot.sec as fastSec, u.sex, u.age, fot.fast_order_take_id as fastOrderTakeId, (select ifnull(avg(score),0) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id=t.id) as commentScore, (select count(*) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id=t.id) as commentCount, (select count(*) from orders where order_taking_id=t.id) as ordersCount from order_taking t LEFT JOIN game g ON t.game_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = t.user_id left join fast_order_take fot on fot.user_id=u.user_id where fot.fast_order_id = #{fastOrderId} and fot.status=1 and t.status=0 and t.isdelete=0 group by t.user_id order by
t.game_id=#{gameId} desc,
t.user_id in (select user_id from tb_user where sex=#{sex}) desc,
t.money>=#{minMoney} desc,
t.money<=#{maxMoney} desc,
t.order_level like concat('%',#{orderLevel},'%') desc,
create_time desc
mapper.update: update fast_order_take set status=3 where fast_order_id=#{fastOrderId}
